content:
Latest update, 7:37 PM ET: Apple says all issues are resolved except for Apple TV.

Apple is currently reporting issues with Apple TV and subscription purchases, with some users also affected by other services. Details below.

Apple currently lists 8 ongoing issues.

Apple's system status page currently shows Apple TV, App Store, Apple Fitness+, Apple Music, Apple Music Subscriptions, Mac App Store, and Subscription Purchases experiencing outages or other ongoing issues.

According to Apple, most issues began at 4:22 PM ET. The company lists App Store, Apple Music, and Mac App Store as undergoing "routine maintenance and not expected to impact users"; the Apple TV outage began at 4:43 PM ET, which Apple says "may be temporarily unavailable due to scheduled maintenance."

During our testing, the Apple TV interface failed to load on iOS, but content still loaded and played normally on other devices.

Shortly before the outage, several apps—including TestFlight, App Store, and Fitness+—began replacing normal interface text with internal localization strings. It's currently unclear whether this is related to Apple's broader issues.

Reports on Downdetector further confirm Apple TV is impacted, though the number of reports appears to have peaked and is now declining, suggesting the outage may be subsiding.

We'll continue to monitor the situation closely and update this article as we learn more or as Apple marks the issues as resolved.

Are you affected? Let us know in the comments.
